items.change: Broadened each plugin's Next.js peer dependency from the Next 15-only range to ^15.0.0 || ^16.0.0 and documented the compatibility change.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 compatibility requiring plugins to accept Next 16 installations.

items.change: Added --webpack to every dev and build script that invokes Next.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 making Turbopack the default while these applications rely on webpack configuration.

items.change: Removed the eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds option from Next configuration.
items.responds_to: The Next.js 16 removal of the Next-config ESLint option.

items.change: Imported .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts from next-env.d.ts and added .next/dev/types/**/*.ts to each development tsconfig include list.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 generating development route declaration files under .next/dev/types.

items.change: Changed the JSX compiler setting from preserve to react-jsx.
items.responds_to: The updated Next.js 16 development TypeScript configuration.

items.change: Stopped excluding next from the general dependency update command while explicitly excluding it from peer-dependency range updates so the intentional ^15.0.0 || ^16.0.0 range is preserved.
items.responds_to: The need to maintain a dual Next.js 15/16 peer range after the upgrade.

items.change: Added a pnpm override pinning Next.js to 16.2.6 in each plugin package.
items.responds_to: Next.js peer-range resolution creating divergent Next.js dependency resolutions in plugin development installations.

items.change: Changed revalidateTag(tag) to revalidateTag(tag, 'max'), retaining a compatibility cast for Next 15 and Next 16 consumers.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 requiring the revalidateTag profile argument and deprecating the one-argument call.

items.change: Changed the first deployment-status poll to seed the cached response without calling router.refresh(); later polls still refresh when the response changes.
items.responds_to: The upgraded Next.js rendering behavior causing the first refresh to re-suspend the server-rendered Suspense boundary and flash the skeleton.

items.change: Replaced the generic deployment skeleton fallback with a row-shaped fallback matching the loaded deployment row's icon, label, spacing, and value height.
items.responds_to: The upgraded Next.js Suspense loading behavior exposing a skeleton reflash and layout shift in the deployment widget.
